arabic text: HAR BIBI NEY ALWADI KEH KAY, LAASH ABBAS TEY AY VAIN KEETA\nMUKH SARAY MAAN GAYE, GHAZI TERAY BAAJO CHADRAN, AA SHIMMR NEY LAIYAAN
english translation text: EVERY BIBI HAS BID FAREWELL AND WALKED PAST THE BODY OF ABBAS (AS),\nNOW THAT HE HAS GONE, SO HAS THEIR PRIDE AND JOY, SHIMR HAS TAKEN AWAY THEIR VEILS.

english translation text: THEY ENTER SHAAM WITH AN AILING PRISONER,\nCOVERING THEIR CHILDREN AND PROTECTING THEIR GRANDFATHER’S RELIGION.
